landing.lead: A guided investigation into the ideas, people, and conflicts that transformed Bitcoin.
landing.ruptureTitle: Bitcoin's history is not what they tell you
landing.ruptureQuote: If you ask ChatGPT, it will repeat a lie.
landing.ruptureBody: You need to know the official story before you can go deeper and understand the real one. And this does not begin or end with Bitcoin.
landing.eraBeforeBody: Cryptography, privacy, digital money, Cypherpunks, P2P networks.
landing.eraBirthBody: A concrete proposal for a concrete problem.
landing.eraAfterBody: Visionaries, conflicts, and decisions that shaped what exists today.
landing.questionTitle: How did Bitcoin become what it is today?
landing.questionLead: Bitcoin did not change only as technology. Its history is also shaped by conflicts of ideas and of people, interests, disagreements, and power groups.
landing.pullCaption: Eight forces pull Bitcoin in different directions. None of them, on its own, explains what it became.
landing.visionsLead: If you don't really understand how it works, and that matters to you, you are in the right place. I have walked hundreds of people through learning Bitcoin's technology. I will explain it as simply as possible so we can then move to a higher level of understanding, always with one-to-one support when you need it. Once you understand the technology, it becomes easier to weigh the different visions of it.
landing.pathLead: A study route in seven questions.
landing.methodQuote: We don't want to tell you what to think about Bitcoin's history. We want to give you enough context to examine it intelligently.
landing.methodLead: The path is not only one teacher's interpretation. It includes reporting, discussions, and articles so you can build your own judgment.
landing.liveTitle: The history is studied at your pace. The conversation happens live.
landing.liveLead: On-demand content plus live sessions during a set window. You can start when you enroll and move at your own pace. At the end, optionally, you can take a knowledge test to earn a completion certificate stored on the blockchain and a souvenir NFT.
landing.livePoint1: Go deeper into events and original sources
landing.livePoint2: Examine interpretations in dialogue with the teacher
landing.livePoint3: Ask questions and talk with other participants
landing.livePoint4: Repeat sessions planned for different paces
landing.windowBody: each session is offered twice, on successive Mondays, from November 9 to December 15, 2026.
landing.fitTitle: Who it is for — and who it is not
landing.fitYes: It may be for you if…
landing.fitNo: It is probably not for you if you are looking for…
landing.guideAlt: Alejandro Veintimilla speaking at a conference.
landing.guideRole: Research guide → student. Not guru → follower.
landing.guideBio1: Founder of Academia Blockchain, economist, and software developer specialized in blockchain. He has been part of the Bitcoin and blockchain ecosystem since 2014–2015, combining an economic perspective with the technical understanding of more than 14 years building software.
landing.guideBio2: Since 2015 he has taught and lectured on Bitcoin, blockchain, money, and power at universities, communities, and international events.
landing.enrollClosed: Enrollment is not available right now.
landing.enrollOpen: The path, guidance through historical sources, and the three live sessions. Anyone who passes the exam receives a certificate on the blockchain and a souvenir NFT.
